evidence.excerpt: Igor Krstić completed his undergraduate and master's studies at the Faculty of Economics in Subotica, University of Novi Sad, and received his PhD in 2009 from the same institution with a dissertation on demand forecasting under price uncertainty in Adriatic coastal tourism. He joined the Department of Management as an assistant professor in 2010 and was promoted to full professor in 2021. His research group focuses on dynamic pricing models, revenue management algorithms, and the behavioural responses of consumers to price volatility in hotels, short-term rental platforms, and airline ancillary services. He teaches courses in strategic management, tourism economics, and quantitative methods for business. The group regularly uses statistical software environments and publicly available booking-platform datasets; no dedicated wet-lab or instrumentation is maintained.
